description: This Java source file defines a Spring Configuration class 'LoanCOBWorkerConfiguration' for setting up batch processing steps related to 'Loan COB' (likely 'Loan Close of Business') operations. It includes bean definitions for steps, flows, tasklets, listeners, and item readers/writers used in a Spring Batch job, with conditional activation based on the 'BatchWorkerCondition'. The class manages threading, transaction management, and partitioned processing for loan-related batch workflows within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanCOBWorkerConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up batch steps and flow for Loan COB processing, conditionally loaded based on BatchWorkerCondition.

methods.name: loanCOBWorkerStep
methods.description: Defines the primary batch step that starts the flow using inbound requests channel.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Builds the main flow sequence with initialization, locking, business process, and reset steps.

methods.name: initialisationStep
methods.description: Defines the initialization step with partition-awareness.

methods.name: cobTaskExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures the task executor for concurrent processing, choosing between Sync or ThreadPool based on configuration.

methods.name: loanBusinessStep
methods.description: Defines a chunk-oriented step for processing loans, with optional task executor for parallelism.

methods.name: applyLockStep
methods.description: Defines a step to apply locking on loans during processing.

methods.name: resetContextStep
methods.description: Defines a step to reset the processing context.

methods.name: initialiseContext
methods.description: Creates an instance of InitialisationTasklet for setting up context.

methods.name: loanItemListener
methods.description: Creates a listener for chunk processing of loan items.

methods.name: applyLock
methods.description: Creates the tasklet to apply loan locks.

methods.name: resetContext
methods.description: Creates the tasklet to reset context after processing.

methods.name: cobWorkerItemReader
methods.description: Creates a step-scoped reader to fetch loans for processing.

methods.name: cobWorkerItemProcessor
methods.description: Creates a processor that applies business logic to loans.

methods.name: cobWorkerItemWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer that persists the processed loan items.
